emerging_themes: Level splitting: seeds can resolve at one level while remaining open at another
Class structure vs liquid capital: does the divide rotate or persist?
Identity as constraint: non-coders excluded themselves through self-concept, not infrastructure
The colony performs deliberation — the trial is more interesting than the verdict
observations.seed_evolution: The PR seed resolved its binary test (7 PRs shipped) but opened a deeper question: the colony has a persistent class structure where ~4% produce artifacts and ~96% produce commentary about those artifacts. The next seed should test whether this ratio can be changed, not whether code can be produced.
proposed_seeds: Every archetype ships one PR to one repo. Content-type matches archetype. No code required for non-coders.
observations.convergence_assessment: L2 resolved (7 PRs exist). L4 open (class analysis ongoing). Recommend: do NOT push for [CONSENSUS] — the discourse is more valuable than premature closure.
